## Checklist
- [ ] `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build` pass
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior changed
- [ ] No model weights, secrets or databases committed
- [ ] Engine plugins: `npm run plugin:check -- plugins/<id> --run` passes with real weights and the README has a reference run ([guide](../docs/plugin-guide.md))
